title: Astral Projection
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (divine focus worth at least 1,000 gp)
text | You and up to eight willing creatures project your astral bodies into the Astral Plane.
text | Your physical bodies remain on the Material Plane in a state of suspended animation.

title: Dominate Person
contents: text | One humanoid must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration.
text | You can use your action to telepathically command the target.

title: Foresight
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (special item worth at least 5,000 gp)
text | Grant a willing creature foresight for the duration.
text | It gains advantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws, and other creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against it.

title: Gate
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (diamond worth at least 5,000 gp)
text | You open a portal linking your plane to another plane you name.
text | Any creature can pass through in either direction.

title: Imprisonment
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (crystal, clasp, and tribute worth at least 5,000 gp)
text | Choose a creature. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be locked in a magical prison.
text | The form of imprisonment (e.g. slumber, bone, etc.) is your choice.

title: Power Word Kill
contents: text | You speak a word of power that can drop a creature instantly.
text | If the target has 100 hit points or fewer, it dies.
text | Otherwise, this spell has no effect.

title: Seeming
contents: text | You change the appearance of any number of creatures you can see within range.
text | The illusions can include clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings.
text | Any physical interaction reveals the disguise.

title: True Polymorph
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (object worth at least 1,000 gp)
text | You transform a creature or object into a new form, which can be a beast, monster, or object.
text | If you concentrate for the full duration, the transformation becomes permanent.

title: Weird
contents: text | You invoke nightmares to assail the minds of up to five creatures you can see within range.
text | Each target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a fail, the target takes 9d6 psychic damage and is frightened for the duration.
